title: From the Vault: Transform: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "Wings that once bore hope are now stained with blood. She is our guardian no longer." —Grete, cathar apostate
Arguel's vision led him into the jungles of Ixalan . . .
. . . to the lost temple of a bat-god of night, eternal enemy to the Threefold Sun.
She now sees only Emrakul's visions.
Upon discovering what had become of her sisters, Sigarda could only weep.
"Unfortunately, all my test animals have died or escaped, so I shall be the final subject. I feel no fear. This is a momentous night." —Laboratory notes, final entry
Those who grasp its hilt soon hear the demon's call.
There are not enough lives on Innistrad to satisfy his thirst for retribution.
She now hears only Emrakul's murmurs.
"People's thoughts just come to me. Sometimes I don't know if it's them or me thinking."
